column2: [intro]
Every day, I wake up and get ready
I play a Joe Dassin record in my bathroom steady
His songs make me sway, make me feel so fine
I like Joe Dassin, my little daily sunshine
Joe Dassin, cool and clever guy
His voice makes me dance, sends me high
I like Joe Dassin, he’s my morning crush
With him, in my dreams, I escape in a rush
I hum his tunes while walking down the street
People look at me strangely, but I don’t care to retreat
Joe Dassin, you light up my days and nights
With you, life is sweet, even in the fights
Joe Dassin, glides on the floor, like a real magician
He sets my body on fire, I'm his biggest fan
I like Joe Dassin, my kitschy, clever hero
Troubles fly away, he makes me feel like a sparrow
[ solo ]
Joe Dassin, cool and clever guy
His voice makes me dance, sends me high
I like Joe Dassin, he’s my morning crush
With him, in my dreams, I escape in a rush
[outro]
